basic_info.description: 223 Waller Street is a light-filled, remodeled, top-level condominium in a beautiful 3-unit building that is set back on an incredibly desirable wide tree-lined block in Hayes Valley. 360-degree exposure with windows on all four sides generously supply every space with natural light and beautiful outlooks without sacrificing privacy. High ceilings and great scale accentuate the light and airy feel. Thoughtfully remodeled, the home seamlessly blends contemporary finishes with timeless period architectural molding and details. The chef's kitchen showcases luxury stainless steel appliances, including a Bertazzoni range and beautiful quartz countertops. The 3 bedroom 1 bathroom layout has great flow and offers flexibility with its double parlor original pocket doors. The home also features hardwood flooring throughout, two electric fireplaces, in-unit laundry, a large attic, 1 car parking and a common garden. This highly sought-after location is remarkably convenient and very close to multiple premier retail and dining corridors of San Francisco, public transportation, freeway access, and parks.
